'''2002 World Championship Greg Shaw DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Greg Shaw]] posted on DeckTech as Force Lightning is TECH after finishing 2nd at the [[2002 World Championship]].<ref name="skilton-26555">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/26555/ Force Lightning is TECH], Stephen Skilton Decktech Archives (Greg "TychoCelchu" Shaw, 10 December 2002)</ref>

== Strategy ==

Shaw built the Hunt Down for the Worlds field against lightsaber combat, [[Watch Your Step]], and [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]]. First-turn Vader to the Cantina is the Watch Your Step line; Colo Claw Fish starts against combat; Force Lightning is the Quiet Mining Colony tech he said to write on the sheet.<ref name="skilton-26555" />
